verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent and compliance service, so outbound webhooks for events such as service-of-process or compliance alerts are a fair question for this kind of product, and the axis applies. The evidence pack has only robots.txt probes showing the content host is behind a Cloudflare challenge. It contains no evidence of registrable outbound HTTP callbacks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
